pii.title: PII Detection
pii.subtitle: Tune how aggressively data is detected and what gets masked.

sensitivity.label: Detection sensitivity
sensitivity.help: Controls how aggressively PII is detected. High catches more potential PII but may have false positives. Low is more precise but may miss some PII.

entities.label: Entities to mask
entities.none: No entity types available. Load a healthy PII model to configure masking.
entities.help: Unchecked types are left unmasked and sent to the AI provider as-is.

regex.label: Custom regex patterns
regex.none: No custom patterns. Use the + button below to add one.
regex.help: Each pattern's name is used as the detected PII type. Patterns use RE2 (Go) syntax and are matched against request content.
regex.saveFailedInvalid: Failed to save patterns. Check that each name and pattern is a valid RE2 expression.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: System-wide interception and custom PII models.

transparentProxy.label: Transparent Proxy
transparentProxy.help: Intercept HTTPS traffic system-wide for automatic PII protection.
transparentProxy.experimentalHelp: This feature requires CA certificate installation and may affect system network settings.

model.label: Load Custom Kiji PII Model
model.requirements: Directory must contain: model.onnx, tokenizer.json, label_mappings.json

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.subtitle: Trust Kiji's root certificate to intercept HTTPS traffic.

setup.title: Set up CA certificate
setup.help: Step-by-step instructions to trust the certificate system-wide or per browser.

certificates.revealHelp: Open the folder containing the proxy's root certificate.

messages.revealDesktopOnly: Reveal in Finder is only available in the desktop app.
